title: Senior Developer - Microsoft .NET
description:
**Job Description**
A Senior Developer - Microsoft .NET is a highly skilled and experienced software engineer specializing in the Microsoft .NET framework and related technologies. You will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications using the .NET ecosystem.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Design, develop, and maintain .NET applications and microservices using C#, ASP.NET Core, and related technologies.
* Collaborate with other developers, architects, and stakeholders to define and implement technical solutions.
* Write clean, well-documented, and testable code adhering to best practices and coding standards.
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely and efficient manner.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the development process and codebase.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest .NET technologies and industry trends.
* Mentor and guide junior developers.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**

* B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech with 5+ years of experience in .NET in framework-based development.
* Good understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.
* Experience with C#, MongoDB, MS SQL Server, Kafka, Camunda or Similar BPMN, IIS,
* Experience with microservices architecture and RESTful APIs.
* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Flexible to work as per Oceania Time Zone (Australia, New Zealand and Japan)

**It would be nice if you also had:**

* Exposure with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Understanding of testing frameworks (e.g., NUnit, xUnit).
* Exposure in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
  
  
Learn more about life at Nokia .
  
  
**Our recruitment process**
We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
  
  
If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
  
  
The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
  
  
**About The Team**
Some of our benefits:
  
  

* Flexible and hybrid working schemes
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with the option to return to work within a year following the birth or adoption of a child (based on eligibility)
* Life insurance to all employees to provide peace of mind and financial security
* Well-being programs to support your mental and physical health
* Opportunities to join and receive support from Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs)
* Employee Growth Solutions to support your personalized career & skills development
* Diverse pool of Coaches & Mentors to whom you have easy access
* A learning environment which promotes personal growth and professional development - for your role and beyond

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Description**
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
  
  
As a Backend Engineer on the Fabric Manager team, you will design and build scalable backend services and orchestration capabilities that power cloud and virtualization deployments for Gigamon’s deep observability platform. You will own the end-to-end development, testing, and delivery of REST APIs, orchestration workflows, and platform abstractions that enable reliable, production-grade experiences for our customers. In this role, you will work across cloud, virtualization, and infrastructure layers to improve performance, resiliency, and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with architecture, infrastructure, DevOps, QA, security, product, and support teams to deliver high-quality, customer-focused solutions and support critical production environments.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end development, testing, and delivery of backend services and orchestration features for Fabric Manager.
* Design and implement reliable, scalable, and maintainable REST APIs, services, and platform abstractions.
* Develop and enhance orchestration workflows for cloud fabric deployment, upgrades, inventory, configuration synchronization, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Contribute to telemetry, statistics, diagnostics, and observability capabilities that improve platform health and operational visibility.
* Work across cloud and virtualization environments to deliver consistent and production-ready orchestration experiences.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, contribute to technical decisions, and influence solutions beyond the immediate feature area.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, DevOps, QA, security, product, and support teams to deliver high-quality customer-focused solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning application logic, APIs, runtime, operating systems, deployment workflows, and cloud integrations.
* Improve performance, resiliency, reliability, automation, test coverage, and operational efficiency across backend platforms.
* Drive engineering quality through code reviews, design reviews, automated testing, documentation, and release readiness activities.
* Mentor engineers, lead knowledge-sharing sessions, and contribute to the technical growth of the team.
* Support customer escalations and production issues by identifying root causes, implementing durable fixes, and sharing lessons learned.
* Evaluate technologies and engineering practices that can improve product quality, maintainability, and development velocity.

What you’ve done
  
  

* Earned a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Accumulated 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience in backend, cloud, or platform development.
* Developed strong expertise in Java and backend application development, preferably using Spring Boot or an equivalent framework.
* Designed and built distributed systems, microservices, control-plane services, or large-scale backend applications.
* Gained strong knowledge of REST APIs, concurrency, multithreading, asynchronous processing, and backend design patterns.
* Worked with cloud, virtualization, or infrastructure orchestration workflows.
* Built a solid understanding of Linux fundamentals, including networking, processes, filesystems, and application runtime behavior.
* Gained experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, caching, messaging, or event-driven systems.
* Developed proficiency with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or similar tools.
* Used Git and CI/CD pipelines, and applied automated testing, code reviews, and modern software development practices.
* Worked with or are familiar with monitoring, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and production diagnostics.
* Used messaging and asynchronous systems such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
* Applied knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, certificates, and service-to-service communication.
* Worked with RBAC, security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and secure platform hardening.
* Used infrastructure automation or configuration management tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Supported customer escalations, performed production debugging, and contributed to cross-functional incident resolution.
* Led or contributed to cross-team initiatives, technical improvements, or platform modernization efforts.
* Gained experience with one or more cloud and virtualization platforms such as AWS, Azure, VMware ESXi, OpenStack, Kubernetes, or Nutanix.

Who you are
  
  

* You demonstrate strong ownership of features and technical initiatives from conception through production delivery.
* You combine deep Java backend expertise with a practical understanding of cloud orchestration and platform workflows.
* You influence architecture and technical decisions across teams while remaining hands-on in implementation.
* You balance sound engineering practices and long-term maintainability with timely product delivery.
* You are a self-motivated, hands-on engineer who thrives in a fast-paced, high-achieving environment.
* You bring strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail.
* You communicate clearly in both written and verbal form and can explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* You collaborate effectively across teams, mentor engineers, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
* You maintain a strong customer focus and respond with urgency and accountability to production issues and release commitments.

As an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and/or local law. For more information, please refer to Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for all qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at (669) 240-2248.
  
  
If your experience and skills closely match our job description but may not necessarily fulfill all requirements, please still apply. Gigamon is on a continued mission to grow and scale an innovative organization. We believe this is best achieved by hiring, celebrating, and respecting people with diverse backgrounds, skills, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
The privacy rights of all individuals including job applicants and candidates are very important to us. Our Gigamon Applicant Privacy Policy, will inform you about how Gigamon Inc. and its direct and indirect subsidiaries collect, use, store, or otherwise process personal information about job applicants and candidates, including through your access and/or use of our careers website and third-party job websites (e.g. LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Naukri, etc.).
  
  
We may use automated tools, including AI-based systems, to help screen and evaluate application materials for this role. These tools are designed to assess job-related qualifications only and do not make final hiring decisions; human reviewers remain involved in the process. Further, Gigamon uses Jobvite, developed by Employ, to screen and evaluate all Gigamon applicant resumes. The system analyzes resumes for skills, experience, and qualifications and processes employment history, education, and skills. This AI-based system is used for all Gigamon positions. For questions, contact [email protected]. You have the right to request reasonable accommodation; to do so, please send a message to [email protected].

title: Senior dashboard developer
description:
The Senior Dashboard Developer is responsible for translating business requirements into intuitive, scalable, and visually consistent Power BI dashboards. They will participate in briefing sessions, build prototypes and mock-ups, and refine them into production‑ready dashboards supported by strong data modelling and performance optimisation. Success requires technical depth in BI development, strong analytical thinking, stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast‑moving environment.

Design, build, and maintain enterprise‑grade Power BI dashboards

* Engage with stakeholders to understand business requirements and produce prototypes (mock-ups, spreadsheets, initial PBIX models).
* Collaborate with the Data Engineering team to integrate data from the data warehouse, OneLake, or Snowflake.
* Build robust data models, DAX measures, and efficient transformations using Power Query (M).
* Develop ETL scripts to ingest and structure data for reporting, including support for modern pipelines (e.g., Fabric Dataflows Gen2, Databricks, PySpark).
* Optimise Power BI dashboards for high performance, usability, and maintainability.
* Ensure dashboard UX follows the established style guide and aligns with the GIM reporting framework.
* Conduct unit testing, peer reviews, support SIT/UAT, and ensure defect resolution.
* Produce essential documentation: Design Specs, User Guides, Release Notes, and Process Docs.
* Contribute to improvements in development standards, Agile practices, and Jira processes.
* Identify data issues or process inefficiencies and contribute to resolution.
* Support the adoption of Q&A, AI features, and advanced analytics in dashboards where applicable.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years hands‑on Power BI development.
* Advanced SQL (T‑SQL/ANSI SQL) and strong DAX expertise.
* Proven experience with Power Query (M), data modelling, and performance optimisation.
* Experience implementing Row Level Security (RLS).
* Strong understanding of data flows from data warehouse to UI.
* Hands‑on experience with ETL processes and tools.
* Experience with source control ( Git).
* Strong analytical skills and ability to identify patterns and insights in data.
* Skilled in requirements analysis, designing specifications, testing, and documentation.
* Excellent communication skills (written & verbal).
* Degree in a numerate discipline (Statistics, Math, Physics, Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science).

**Nice to Have (Technical Skills & Experience)**

* Experience with OneLake/Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouse, or Dataflows Gen2.
* Experience with SQL optimisation and modelling.
* Hands‑on experience with Python or PySpark for analysis.
* Familiarity with data science concepts.
* Experience with KQL for Log Analytics or Fabric monitoring.
* Familiarity with advanced Power BI features such as AI visuals or Q&A.

title: Manager - Navigation, Guidance & Control (Autonomous Systems)
description:
Manager / Senior Manager – Navigation, Guidance & Control (Autonomous Marine Systems)
  
  
Responsible for the design, development, integration and validation of
  
  
Navigation, Guidance & Control (NGC) systems for autonomous underwater and un-crewed marine platforms
  
  
The role shall develop robust navigation and state-estimation solutions using INS/IMU/DVL/GNSS/depth and other onboard sensors, including sensor fusion, dead-reckoning and GPS-denied navigation.
  
  
Develop and validate
  
  
guidance, waypoint/path-following and vehicle-control algorithms
  
  
, including PID/adaptive control, control-surface/thruster allocation, actuator command generation and degraded-mode behaviour. Support integration of navigation,autonomy, platform-control and mission-management software with onboard sensors, actuators and vehicle systems.
  
  
Develop and utilise
  
  
physics-based vehicle models, simulation, SIL/HIL and data-replay environments
  
  
for algorithm development,tuning, verification and validation prior to vehicle deployment. Plan and support laboratory, harbour and sea trials; analyse vehicle performance and recorded data; identify root causes and progressively improve navigation and control performance.
  
  
Work closely with Systems Engineering, Software, Electrical/Electronics, Mechanical/Hydrodynamics, Payload and Integration teams to define system requirements, interfaces, operating behaviours and verification criteria. Contribute to technical documentation, design reviews, supplier/technology evaluations and development of reusable NGC and simulation capabilities across UMS platforms.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on capability in
  
  
AUV/marine robotics, NGC, INS/IMU/DVL integration, KF/EKF sensor fusion, GPS-denied navigation, control-system design, C/C++/Python/MATLAB, vehicle modelling/simulation and system integration/testing

title: Senior Mortgage Systems Developer
description:
SWBC is seeking a talented individual to design, develop, integrate, and support enterprise mortgage technology solutions, with emphasis on ICE Encompass LOS, SQL/data development, APIs, workflow automation, reporting, and secure business applications. The role exists to provide senior\-level technical expertise for complex mortgage systems, production support, vendor integrations, and technology modernization efforts that support business operations and compliance\-focused execution.
   

  

**Why You'll Love This Role**
 This senior technical role gives a candidate the opportunity to build, integrate, and support mission\-critical mortgage technology solutions that directly improve operational efficiency, data quality, reporting, and user experience. The position combines deep Encompass LOS expertise, SQL/data development, application development, integration, automation, and emerging technology adoption in a highly collaborative environment.
   

  

**Essential Duties Include The Following**
* Develop, enhance, and support mortgage technology solutions, with primary focus on ICE Encompass LOS and related mortgage systems.
* Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server/T\-SQL objects including stored procedures, functions, views, ETL processes, and operational reporting solutions.
* Design, build, and support API\-driven integrations and workflow automations across mortgage, document, servicing, vendor, and enterprise platforms.
* Develop and maintain secure, scalable business applications using modern software development practices, object\-oriented design, REST APIs, JSON/XML, and .NET/C\# technologies.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, tune system/database performance, and coordinate timely resolution across internal teams and third\-party providers.
* Support DevOps, source control, CI/CD, cloud, monitoring, operational support, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices for mortgage technology applications.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions; document design, testing, deployment, and support procedures.
* Identify and implement automation and emerging technology opportunities, including practical use of AI\-assisted development tools to improve efficiency, quality, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Performs all other duties as assigned.


**Serious Candidates Will Possess The Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Management Information System, or related field from an accredited four\-year college or university required.
* Certified Application Developer preferred.
* Minimum of ten (10\) years of experience to include designing and building applications.
* Experience with mortgage origination systems, preferably ICE Encompass LOS.
* Experience with Encompass APIs, Developer Connect, Data Connect, Partner Connect, and third\-party mortgage technology integrations preferred.
* Understanding of mortgage origination, servicing, document management, and vendor ecosystems.
* Advanced Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL development skills.
* Experience developing stored procedures, functions, views, ETL processes, and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Ability to troubleshoot production issues, optimize queries, and support operational reporting.
* Understanding of database design, data modeling, and data governance principles.
* Strong knowledge of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) and modern software development practices.
* Hands\-on experience with; C\#, .NET / .NET Core, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, JSON/XML
* Experience developing and supporting secure, maintainable business applications.
* Angular, React, and cloud platform experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of DevOps principles, GitHub Enterprise, CI/CD pipelines, AWS cloud services, Infrastructure as Code (CDK with Python), containerization, monitoring, and operational support practices.
* Experience designing and supporting system integrations and workflow automation solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills across multiple systems and platforms.
* Experience integrating mortgage, servicing, document, or vendor platforms preferred.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar technologies to improve development efficiency, code quality, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Experience identifying and implementing automation opportunities that streamline business processes, enhance reporting, and improve operational effectiveness.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled solutions, API\-driven automation, and emerging technologies that support business and technology objectives.
* Demonstrated willingness to learn and adopt new technologies to improve productivity and deliver business value.
* Understanding of AI\-related concepts and practical business applications preferred.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of emerging technologies.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and time\-management skills.
* Excellent analytical thinking and problem solving skills.
* Able to program in languages such as C\#, Hypertext Markup Language, PowerShell, Java (J2EE) etc.
* Able to sit for long periods of time performing sedentary activities.
* Able to stand, stoop, and kneel to file for long periods of time.
* Able to push, pull, and lift up to 20 lbs. of files, supplies, documents, or other related items.


***SWBC offers\*:***
* Competitive overall compensation package
* Work/Life balance
* Employee engagement activities and recognition awards
* Years of Service awards
* Career enhancement and growth opportunities
* Leadership Academy and Mentor Program
* Continuing education and career certifications
* Variety of healthcare coverage options
* Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement plans
* Lucrative Wellness Program
* Based upon employee eligibility


**Additional Information**
 SWBC is a Substance\-Free Workplace and requires pre\-employment drug testing.
   

  

 Please note, SWBC does not hire tobacco users as allowed by law.

 Manufacturing / Production Engineering
 



**Experience:** 
 3–8 Years

 We are looking for a skilled
 **CNC / VMC Programmer** 
 to support our advanced furniture manufacturing operations. The role will be responsible for programming, optimizing and troubleshooting CNC machining processes, ensuring accurate production of components as per design and quality requirements.

* Develop and optimize
 **CNC/VMC programs** 
 for machining operations.
* Convert

 using CAM software.

 .
* Create and optimize

 for efficient material utilization.
* Generate and validate

 programs and ensure error\-free machine execution.
* Interpret

 .
* Support machining of

 .
* Conduct program simulations and identify potential machining or collision issues before production.
* Troubleshoot programming, tooling, machine and dimensional issues during production.
* Work closely with
 **Design, Production, Quality and Engineering teams** 
 to improve manufacturability and cycle time.
* Optimize CNC processes for
 **productivity, quality, material utilization and machine efficiency** 
 .
* Maintain CNC programs, tooling data, process sheets and relevant technical documentation.



  





**Required Skills** 



* CNC / VMC Programming
* 5\-Axis CNC Programming
* CAM Programming \& Toolpath Optimization
* G\-code / M\-code
* AutoCAD / SolidWorks
* CNC Routing \& Machining
* Nesting \& Material Optimization
* Tool Selection \& Cutting Parameters
* CNC Machine Setup \& Troubleshooting
* CAD/CAM Interpretation
* DFM \& Process Optimization
* Production \& Quality Control



  





**Qualification** 



* Diploma / ITI / B.E. / B.Tech in
 **Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing or related engineering discipline** 
 .
* 3–8 years of relevant experience in CNC/VMC programming and manufacturing.



  





**Preferred Experience** 




 Candidates with experience in
 **furniture, woodworking, modular furniture, kitchen manufacturing, panel processing, solid wood machining or highly automated manufacturing environments** 
 will be preferred.
 



 Experience with
 **5\-axis CNC routers, automated drilling, nesting and CAD\-to\-CNC workflows** 
 will be an added advantage.

title: Network Automation Solution Developer
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Automation Solution Developer, you will validate Service Portals and ensure their reliability for leading telecom operators. Working with agile, cross\-functional teams, you will develop and execute test strategies for orchestration, automation, and service assurance across IP/MPLS networks. You will leverage test automation tools, troubleshoot issues, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to continuous integration and delivery, helping deliver high\-quality network automation solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and implement comprehensive end\-to\-end test strategies for Service Portals, focusing on performance and reliability.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Robot Framework for regression, functional, and system testing.
* Validate complex IP/MPLS network topologies, ensuring thorough testing of orchestration and automation functionalities.
* Troubleshoot issues, conduct root cause analysis, and collaborate with developers to drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated testing within the release process.
* Review and assess product requirements and design documents to ensure they meet testability standards.
* Mentor junior QA engineers, providing guidance and participating in peer reviews to enhance team skills.
